description: Foundation: install Firebase + AsyncStorage + the two Expo pickers via expo install, add the expo-image-picker config plugin to app.json, add .env.example, and build the entire src/services/firebase/ layer (config singletons + types + auth/users/favorites/reviews/tasks/files + auth-errors). This feature creates every Firebase service module with its full signatures so later features (auth, favorites, reviews, tasks, documents) can wire into stable surfaces. No screens/context/wrappers change here. Ground everything in design.md's module-surface snippets. This feature is a prerequisite for ALL others.
steps: Run `npx expo install firebase @react-native-async-storage/async-storage expo-document-picker expo-image-picker` from the worktree root (NOT npm/yarn add) so SDK-57-compatible versions resolve (FR-X5, AC-31). Confirm these are Expo Go compatible per https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/.

app.json: append a third plugins entry ['expo-image-picker', { 'photosPermission': 'O Elder usa suas fotos para anexar exames e receitas ao seu perfil.' }] AFTER the existing 'expo-router' and 'expo-splash-screen' entries, leaving those two verbatim. expo-document-picker needs no plugin entry. Do not touch experiments.typedRoutes/reactCompiler. (design.md 'Dependencies and configuration changes'.)

Create .env.example at the worktree root documenting the six EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* keys with EMPTY values and the PT comment header from design.md. It is docs-only; it must never be copied to a live .env (?? only fires on undefined). .gitignore already ignores .env*.local so a developer's local override is never committed (NFR-5, AC-29).

Create src/services/firebase/config.ts EXACTLY per design.md's single authoritative snippet: read process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* with committed defaults, initializeApp guarded by getApps()/getApp(), initializeAuth wrapped in try/catch falling back to getAuth(app) on Fast-Refresh re-init, getFirestore(app), getStorage(app); export { app, auth, db, storage }. Fill the committed default values from the task scope: apiKey=AIzaSyB20TY1sKpIW4u3bob3A0hWCK0MgE_Dl6A, authDomain=gen-lang-client-0201344960.firebaseapp.com, projectId=gen-lang-client-0201344960, storageBucket=gen-lang-client-0201344960.firebasestorage.app, messagingSenderId=223516053542, appId=1:223516053542:web:74fe1f74a03673722496e7. NO measurementId, NO getAnalytics (FR-X4/AC-27).

Persistence import gate: write the `import { getReactNativePersistence } from '@firebase/auth'` line used by config.ts and run `npx tsc --noEmit`. If tsc RESOLVES the symbol, keep this import. If tsc FAILS to resolve it for ANY reason (customConditions not set, symbol moved/removed, export-map change — a web-confirmed common failure where the symbol is missing from typings even when runtime works), do NOT force it: implement a tiny hand-written Persistence adapter over AsyncStorage (_isAvailable/_set/_get/_remove) in config.ts and pass it to initializeAuth(app, { persistence: adapter }). Record which path was taken in findings.

Create src/services/firebase/types.ts: UserProfile = { name: string; role: AccountRole; email: string; createdAt: Timestamp | null } (import AccountRole from '@/components/types', Timestamp type from 'firebase/firestore'); plus ReviewDoc = { id, rating, comment, author, authorUid, createdAt: Timestamp | null }, TaskDoc = { id, dayKey, title, time, day, icon: string, done, order }, and StoredDocument = { name, fullPath, url, size?, contentType?, updated? }.

Create src/services/firebase/users.ts: normalizeRole(raw: unknown): AccountRole (returns raw when it is 'elder'|'family'|'partner', else 'family'); createProfile(uid, { name, role, email }): Promise<void> via setDoc(doc(db,'users',uid), { name, role: normalizeRole(role), email, createdAt: serverTimestamp() }); getProfile(uid): Promise<UserProfile|null> via getDoc, returns null when !exists, else maps data through normalizeRole and returns { name, role, email, createdAt: data.createdAt ?? null }.

Create src/services/firebase/auth.ts (the ONLY module besides config.ts importing firebase/auth): signUp({ name, role, email, password }): Promise<User> = createUserWithEmailAndPassword then users.createProfile(uid, {name,role,email}); on a profile-write failure, AWAIT cleanup of the just-created auth user (deleteUser(cred.user); if that throws, await firebaseSignOut(auth)) BEFORE rejecting. signIn({ email, password }): Promise<UserCredential> = signInWithEmailAndPassword. logout(): Promise<void> = signOut(auth) (import signOut as firebaseSignOut). observeAuth(cb): () => void = onAuthStateChanged(auth, cb) returning its unsubscribe. NOTE: auth.signUp here does NOT guard partner — the partner guard lives in AccountContext (FEAT-002) before auth.signUp is called.

Create src/services/firebase/auth-errors.ts: toPtMessage(e: unknown): string that reads a 'code' field when present and maps common auth/* codes (auth/email-already-in-use, auth/weak-password, auth/invalid-email, auth/invalid-credential, auth/user-not-found, auth/wrong-password, auth/too-many-requests) plus the sentinel 'app/partner-not-available' -> 'O Portal do Parceiro ainda nao esta disponivel. Em breve!' and 'app/profile-write-failed' -> 'Nao foi possivel concluir o cadastro. Tente novamente.' to Portuguese; generic fallback 'Algo deu errado. Tente novamente.' Never surface a raw Firebase code.

Create src/services/firebase/favorites.ts: listFavorites(uid): Promise<string[]> via getDocs(collection(db,'users',uid,'favorites')) -> doc ids; addFavorite(uid, businessId): Promise<void> via setDoc(doc(db,'users',uid,'favorites',businessId), { businessId, createdAt: serverTimestamp() }); removeFavorite(uid, businessId): Promise<void> via deleteDoc.

Create src/services/firebase/reviews.ts: listReviews(businessId): Promise<ReviewDoc[]> via getDocs(query(collection(db,'businesses',businessId,'reviews'), orderBy('createdAt','desc'))) mapping each doc to ReviewDoc with createdAt ?? null; addReview(businessId, { rating, comment, author, authorUid }): Promise<ReviewDoc> via addDoc(..., { rating, comment, author, authorUid, createdAt: serverTimestamp() }) returning the new ReviewDoc (createdAt may be null locally).

Create src/services/firebase/tasks.ts: listTasks(uid): Promise<TaskDoc[]> via getDocs ordered by `order`; seedTasks(uid, seed: TaskSeed[]): Promise<TaskDoc[]> using writeBatch with fixed seed doc ids (t1, t2) so a double first-launch converges rather than duplicating; completeTask(uid, taskId): Promise<void> via updateDoc(doc(db,'users',uid,'tasks',taskId), { done: true }). Define the TaskSeed input type (TaskDoc without id/done, with order).

Create src/services/firebase/files.ts: uploadDocument(uid, { uri, name, mimeType? }): Promise<StoredDocument> = fetch(uri)->blob(), uploadBytes(ref(storage,'users/'+uid+'/documents/'+`${Date.now()}_${safeName}`), blob, { contentType }), then getDownloadURL; strip the timestamp prefix for the displayed name. listDocuments(uid): Promise<StoredDocument[]> via listAll(ref(storage,'users/'+uid+'/documents')) resolving getMetadata + getDownloadURL per item. deleteDocument(fullPath): Promise<void> via deleteObject(ref(storage, fullPath)). Default a missing name to the last uri path segment.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` from the worktree root and fix any errors introduced by the new modules.
acceptance_criteria: firebase, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, expo-document-picker, expo-image-picker appear in package.json at SDK-57-compatible versions installed via expo install (AC-31).
app.json plugins contains exactly three entries ending with the expo-image-picker plugin carrying the photosPermission string; the first two entries are unchanged.
.env.example exists at the worktree root with the six EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* keys (empty values) (AC-29).

src/services/firebase/ contains config.ts, auth.ts, auth-errors.ts, users.ts, favorites.ts, reviews.ts, tasks.ts, files.ts, types.ts; only config.ts calls initializeApp/initializeAuth/getFirestore/getStorage and there is no getAnalytics call anywhere (AC-26/27).

config.ts initializes Auth with React Native AsyncStorage persistence (either @firebase/auth getReactNativePersistence verified by tsc, or the AsyncStorage adapter fallback) (AC-28); findings record which path was taken.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` both pass with no errors (AC-30).
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from c:/Users/savio/OneDrive/Tier2/Elder/elder/.worktrees/firebase-core and confirm zero errors.
Run `npx expo lint` from the same directory and confirm zero errors.
Confirm (read package.json / app.json / .env.example) the dependency, plugin, and env-example criteria above hold.
findings:
PERSISTENCE PATH = AsyncStorage adapter FALLBACK (design.md step 3), NOT the @firebase/auth getReactNativePersistence import. Installed firebase@^13 (resolved 13.x via `npx expo install`). The RN typings file node_modules/@firebase/auth/dist/rn/index.rn.d.ts DOES export getReactNativePersistence, but the authoritative gate failed: `npx tsc --noEmit` under the project's real tsconfig raised TS2305 'Module "@firebase/auth" has no exported member getReactNativePersistence' (the configured module resolution selects @firebase/auth's default/browser entry, not the react-native entry; expo/tsconfig.base's customConditions did not surface the RN export to tsc). Per the mandated gate (tsc must resolve it), I did NOT force the import. config.ts now defines a tiny hand-written Persistence adapter over AsyncStorage implementing type:'LOCAL' + _isAvailable/_set/_get/_remove (+ no-op _addListener/_removeListener), cast via `as unknown as Persistence` (imported type from firebase/auth) and passed to initializeAuth(app, { persistence: adapter }). _set JSON.stringifies values and _get JSON.parses them, matching how the Firebase RN persistence stores blobs.

RUNTIME NOT PROVEN: a green tsc/lint does NOT prove the Firebase credentials or storageBucket are runnable. The committed config.ts defaults (apiKey/authDomain/projectId/storageBucket=gen-lang-client-0201344960.firebasestorage.app/messagingSenderId/appId) and the AsyncStorage persistence adapter both require manual Expo Go smoke-testing (real signup/login session survives reload; one real document upload+list to confirm the storageBucket). A wrong storageBucket fails silently at the first uploadBytes/listAll, not at init.

TOOLING ADDED to run the mandated verification (project had NO eslint config anywhere and `npx expo lint` prompts to scaffold one interactively): installed devDeps eslint + eslint-config-expo via `npx expo install --dev` and created the standard Expo flat eslint.config.js (expo-config/flat, ignores dist/*). Also created expo-env.d.ts (/// <reference types="expo/types" />) which the worktree was missing (gitignored, normally generated by Expo tooling); without it tsc raised TS2882 on the pre-existing `import '../../global.css'` in src/app/_layout.tsx because the '*.css' ambient module lives in expo/types. tsconfig already lists expo-env.d.ts in include. Both files are standard Expo-generated/scaffolded content, not custom.

FINAL VERIFICATION (worktree root): `npx tsc --noEmit` => 0 errors. `npx expo lint` => 0 errors, 3 warnings — all in pre-existing untouched files (SignupScreen.tsx:24 stray `;3` no-unused-expressions, account-context.tsx:24 no-unused-expressions, DiscoverScreen.tsx:53 exhaustive-deps); these are FEAT-002+ territory and were not introduced here.

FOR LATER FEATURES: (1) Service layer surfaces are stable — import singletons app/auth/db/storage from '@/services/firebase/config'; never re-init. (2) auth.ts is the ONLY module besides config.ts importing firebase/auth; auth.signUp does NOT guard partner (FEAT-002 AccountContext must throw the { code: 'app/partner-not-available' } sentinel BEFORE calling auth.signUp). (3) auth-errors.toPtMessage(e) already maps the partner sentinel and app/profile-write-failed plus the common auth/* codes; signUp's profile-write-failure path rethrows the raw Firestore error (not an app/profile-write-failed sentinel) after awaiting deleteUser/signOut cleanup — if a feature wants that specific PT message it must map/throw the sentinel itself. (4) ReviewDoc.createdAt and UserProfile.createdAt are Timestamp|null (serverTimestamp echoes null locally) — never call .toMillis() on them client-side; addReview returns createdAt:null locally. (5) tasks.seedTasks uses fixed ids t1,t2,... (idempotent-ish via setDoc; it does NOT itself check for existing docs, so callers should only seed when listTasks returns empty). TaskSeed = Omit<TaskDoc,'id'|'done'>. (6) files.uploadDocument prefixes stored object names with `${Date.now()}_` and strips it for the displayed name; listDocuments resolves getMetadata+getDownloadURL per item; deleteDocument takes a fullPath. (7) app.json now has three plugins ending with expo-image-picker (photosPermission PT string); .env.example is docs-only with empty values (do NOT copy to a live .env — config.ts uses ?? which only fires on undefined).
